|game_text='''0 side — He Is The Chosen One'''

Deploy Jedi Council Chamber (with Prophecy Of The Force there), Ewok Village, and I Feel The Conflict. For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Episode I] or [Episode VII] characters or locations (except Obi-Wan and Yoda). Luke may not be captured by Bring Him Before Me unless there are two cards stacked on Insignificant Rebellion during any move phase. While this side up, you may initiate battles for free. Flip this card if Luke or a Jedi at a battleground site (unless an opponent's character of ability &gt; 4 is).

'''7 side — He Will Bring Balance'''

{While} this side up, once during your control phase, may peek at up to X cards from the top of your Reserve Deck, where X = number of battlegrounds you occupy; take one into hand and shuffle your Reserve Deck. During your draw phase, may retrieve any one card; opponent may stack a card from hand on I Feel The Conflict to place that card out of play instead. {Flip} this card (unless Vader crossed over) if opponent's character of ability &gt; 4 at a battleground site or you do not have Luke (or a Jedi) at a battleground site.

|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E3 (version 4 of 8) of the Virtual Modern flip objective. A flip objective is one card with two sides; each version below is a published state of the card: a new PC card image of either side, or an errata-sheet slip. Dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository or the build dates of the errata-sheet PDFs. Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the 7 side''' (crops of the two published images): [[File:V8-L-hewillbringbalance-2022-03-21-sheet-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V8-L-hewillbringbalance-2018-07-08.gif]]) → [[File:V8-L-hewillbringbalance-2022-03-21-sheet-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V8-L-hewillbringbalance-errata-sheet-2022-03-21.png]]).
